project.sportfit.description: Built and maintained a full-featured PrestaShop e-commerce platform for SportFit.ee, delivering end-to-end technical ownership from infrastructure to marketing integrations. Developed two custom PHP modules — a loyalty program system and a GDPR-compliant user deletion flow — extending the platform's core functionality to meet business and legal requirements. Integrated Montonio payment gateway to enable seamless local payment processing for Estonian customers. Connected the store to Facebook (Catalog & Ads) and Google Ads to support paid acquisition campaigns, and configured automated email marketing with customer list collection to drive retention. Set up automated backups to ensure business continuity and data safety. Optimized site performance with a focus on TTFB reduction and technical SEO — including a custom robots.txt configuration for crawler management — resulting in improved search visibility and user experience. Implemented a custom front-end design and integrated 1C inventory exchange to keep product data in sync with internal systems. Tracked traffic and purchase analytics to support data-driven decision making.
project.sportfit.stack: PrestaShop, PHP, JavaScript, MySQL, Facebook Catalog API, Google Ads, Montonio, 1C integration
project.bombbar.description: Built and maintained a full-featured PrestaShop e-commerce platform for Bombbar.ee, delivering end-to-end technical ownership from infrastructure to marketing integrations. Developed custom product management solutions and integrated SEO optimization for the Estonian market. Connected the store to Facebook for social commerce and implemented performance optimizations for reliable operation.
project.bombbar.stack: PrestaShop, PHP, JavaScript, MySQL, Facebook Integration, SEO
project.cuentos-con-valores.description: Built a multilingual React application from scratch for CuentosConValor.es — a Spanish-language content platform — delivering a complete solution from architecture to deployment. Architected the frontend in React with Strapi as a headless CMS backend, enabling non-technical content editors to manage stories and pages independently without developer involvement. Implemented multilingual support to serve content across multiple languages, and integrated technical SEO — including meta tags, structured data, and dynamic routing — to maximize organic search visibility. Developed custom UI components tailored to the project's design requirements, and handled full deployment and DevOps setup to bring the application to production.
project.cuentos-con-valores.stack: React, Strapi, REST API, i18n, SEO
project.makeup-narva.description: Designing and building a multilingual booking platform for a massage therapy business in Narva, Estonia — supporting Russian, Estonian, and English audiences from a single codebase. Architected a modern JAMstack solution using Astro for the frontend and Strapi with PostgreSQL as the headless CMS backend, giving the client full control over content without developer dependency. Integrated Stebby — a popular Estonian employee benefits platform — to allow customers to pay for services through their health and wellness benefit packages.Built a custom booking system enabling clients to schedule appointments directly through the site. Implemented technical SEO across all three locales with dynamic meta tags, structured data, and locale-aware routing to maximize visibility in local search. Set up a full CI/CD pipeline for automated deployment, ensuring reliable and consistent delivery of updates.
project.makeup-narva.stack: Astro, React, Strapi, PostgreSQL, Stebby API, i18n (RU/ET/EN), CI/CD
